notes.title: New Update: 0.2
notes.content:
Snow Arena continues to evolve. With a little development, we're here with the new version. We have made some updates and bug fixes in this release. New maps will come in the next update. Write the features you want in the comments, we will evaluate them all.

Current Update:

 The snowball effect has changed.
 Improved sense of snowball firing.
 Snowball sounds changed.
 Bugs fixed.
